title: One Summer
about: Looking back on a single summer that changed far more than its twenty-two days should have.
description: This track reflects on how one short season can become a permanent dividing line in a life. What looked like just twenty-two days of rehearsals, fairgrounds, performances, friendships, first love, and loss became something that lasted far beyond the calendar. It's about the strange way a brief summer can carry more weight than entire years and continue shaping everything that comes after.
lyrics: Twenty-two days doesn't sound like much,
Until you live them one by one.
The stage became a second home,
By the time September found me,
Just a handful of ordinary days.
A stage, a fair, a quiet garden,
The costumes all were packed away,
The crowds went home, the lights went dark,
Life kept moving like it should,
Still a piece of that one summer
One first love, one broken heart,
